faqs.a: Inside one app, add a Client field and a view per client. People you invite to the workspace see what the workspace holds, so plan who you invite.
An AI agent can read the week’s tasks or a sheet of numbers and draft the update email. You review and send.

faqs.q: Does it work with our project tool?
faqs.a: Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Notion and monday.com are in viaSocket’s catalog. Name yours in the sentence to Captain.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: One workspace holds your apps and records; it is not a client portal your clients log in to. It does not run ad accounts or post on social media for clients. Client emails always wait for your approval.
